Gabe: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands on GTM, pipeline, and partnerships. Ask short Qs here and we'll answer live.

Tom: What is the revised Q2 net-new target? Deck had one number, breakouts said another.

Anika (CRO): Official Q2 net-new ARR = $2.3M. We adjusted mix to favor partner-assisted deals; ~900k expected partner-influenced.

Tom: Cool. Any immediate quota or territory moves?

Anika (CRO): No quota resets. Small reassignments (2-4 accounts) to balance load; RevOps will notify people today. Major territory remaps next quarter.

Priya (Head of Partnerships): Marketplace updates: AWS soft-launch next week for a handful of pilot customers. Azure targeted for late Q3. Co-sell pilots with two SIs starting onboarding Wednesday.

Ben (RevOps): Funnel quick peek: SQL volume +5% MoM, MQL->SQL conversion slightly down. Running a messaging AB test; results in 10 days.

Tom: For partner-sourced deals, how is credit assigned? We had confusion on expansions.

Priya (Head of Partnerships): Short: partner referral credit if they originated the intro and participate in first call. AE keeps expansion credit unless partner brings a documented expansion. Full matrix will be posted.

Gabe: On GTM motions: 1) PLG land & expand, 2) partner-assisted enterprise for regulated verticals, 3) performance-led SMB upsell. Use these to prioritize inbound.

Anika (CRO): Action items: RevOps to publish one-pager playbooks per motion by next Wed (Ben). Priya to post partner-credit matrix by EOD Fri.

allhands-bot: Notes and deck uploaded -> https://drive.redwood.company/allhands/1772109876-gtm-followup.pdf

Gabe: Thanks team. If any deal >250k is blocked, DM me. :thumbsup:
